scenes.stage_direction: The search becomes a confrontation with named decision-makers. Each signed record changes a concrete next step.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: There is a specific process for reaching Ethan now. We can challenge a failure to follow it.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then put each next step where I can see it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Victor has learned how much of his leverage has gone.

metadata.evidence_summary: The team gains a specific institutional route toward Ethan.
